product_one_liner.value: Haptiq provides AI-native enterprise platforms that unify data, automate workflows and deliver actionable insights for private equity firms, enterprises, institutions and governments.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link in the site navigation/footer; sales inquiries go through a contact form, and no pricing page was retrievable.

named_customers.notes: The customer case studies reviewed are anonymized; they do not establish two named customers.

founded_year.notes: Company profiles date Haptiq, formerly Webonise, to 2009; its rebrand is not the founding date.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains business, product and technical thought leadership, but not two engineer-authored accounts of how Haptiq builds its product.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help portal is linked; the public resource is a single FAQ page, not a multi-article documentation site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An AI Engineer posting is dated 2026-10-24; the recruitment board also lists Head of Data Engineering & AI.

model_provider.notes: Haptiq’s technology leader publicly describes its production multi-agent enterprise platform as built on OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph and Pydantic; no specific OpenAI model is named.

compliance_certs.notes: No achieved certification among the five requested is claimed in the legal material reviewed. The DPA mentions SOC 2 Type II only as an example assessment framework, not a completed certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest identified outside investment was Pearl Street Equity’s acquisition/investment in predecessor Webonise in April 2022; amount undisclosed, so amount_usd is omitted. This was a buyout, not a disclosed venture round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing is the April 2022 buyout, before the 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Readable listings show engineering roles, a sales/GTM director and a Business Development Associate, but no qualifying SDR, BDR or Account Executive title; the associate title is not treated as a representative title.

launched_6mo.notes: The 2026-05-28 release introduced an Olympus Credit compliance engine, company module, compliance-testing dashboard, rules interface and 19 validated concentration tests, plus Orion connectors.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bhuvan Khanna’s profile describes him as Haptiq’s General Manager and Chief Product Officer and dates that role January 2024–May 2026, establishing a C-level departure within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Job descriptions name these CRM systems for lead routing, pipeline management and forecasting; wording includes examples/experience requirements rather than an exclusive deployment declaration.
